label: TP
reason: Three alerts identified: (1) java/xss at L82-L89 - user input flows to HTML response output via encodeForHTML() (mitigated but still flagged); (2) java/path-injection at L77 - user input directly used in new File() without validation enabling path traversal; (3) java/error-message-exposure at L94-L99 - exception message logged to System.out exposing internal error details. Path injection and error message exposure are clear TP findings.

evidence.note: Path injection: new File(fileName) uses user-controlled param without validation, enabling directory traversal
Error message exposure: Exception message printed to System.out revealing internal error details
XSS alert: User input flows to HTML response output (though mitigated by encodeForHTML())
